assessment: Slusarczyk et al. present a well written manuscript focused on understanding the mechanisms underlying aging of erythrophagocytic macrophages in the spleen (RPM) and its relationship to iron loading with age. Importantly, the manuscript demonstrates that RPM erythrophagocytic capacity is diminished with age, restored in iron restricted diet fed aged mice. The main conclusion of the manuscript points to accumulation of unavailable insoluble forms of iron as both causing and resulting from RPM failure, likely a consequence of decreased ferroportin expression on RPMs in the spleen.
